unit.why: After a short Zohar citation on the radiant 'garment' of the righteous, the author gives a first-person memorate: he saw his master-uncle's face shining at Minhah of Rosh Hashanah and fell back in fear.

stories.start_quote: ואני זכיתי לראות פני מורי דודי
stories.end_quote: לכותל על רגע ולא ראיתי עוד
stories.summary_en: The narrator saw the face of his teacher and uncle shining like a heavenly rainbow during Minhah on Rosh Hashanah and fell backward in fear; the master noticed and turned his face to the wall for a moment, and the radiance was not seen again.

quotes: שהי׳ פניו מבהיק ומאיר כעין קשת שלמעלה
tags.why: The tzaddik's face radiates light as a sign of his holiness.
The narrator falls back in dread.

The scene is set on Rosh Hashanah.
